scientific_question: What information is required to turn a crop ranking into an allocation?
core_conclusion: A ranking becomes a decision only after cardinal payoffs, uncertainty, feasibility and optimizer selection are specified
hero_panel: Decision architecture from score to stochastic profits to feasible/risk set to optimal face
supporting_panels: Observable versus latent inputs; possible/universal/selected reversal; five-question study map
required_source_data: GOAL-14 canonical definitions; GOAL-11 traceability map; no generated numerical values
statistics_and_uncertainty: No inferential statistics; every arrow typed as definition, assumption, optimization or evidence link
evidence_gate: GOAL-14 definitions and theorem classification accepted
reviewer_risk: A visual pipeline may imply causality or that observed acreage is an optimizer

scientific_question: How do margin, risk and feasible geometry create reversal?
core_conclusion: Reversal arises from the position of the optimal face relative to ranking half-spaces, with margin, operational and risk boundaries producing distinguishable geometries
hero_panel: Two- or three-crop feasible-region geometry with ranking boundary, objective direction, CVaR boundary and optimal face
supporting_panels: Margin-only case; feasibility-forced case; risk-induced case; set-valued case with face interval
required_source_data: GOAL-14 analytic examples and proofs; GOAL-12 validated geometry anchors
statistics_and_uncertainty: Exact analytic boundaries plus numerical residuals and face tolerances; no probability claim
evidence_gate: GOAL-14 propositions proved and GOAL-12 anchor recovery/convergence pass
reviewer_risk: A selected point can conceal the optimal face; schematic geometry may be mistaken for empirical frequency

scientific_question: Which model blocks change allocation, profit and downside risk?
core_conclusion: Adding cardinal margins, operational constraints, CVaR and dependence produces separable, quantitatively audited changes in decisions and local optimality pressures
archetype: quantitative grid with dominant nested-model panel
hero_panel: M0-to-M4 allocation transition for prespecified confirmatory anchors or aggregate controlled contrasts
supporting_panels: Expected profit and true-law CVaR; active constraints and dual-pressure decomposition; face/order attribution intervals
required_source_data: GOAL-12 nested-model outputs, KKT pressure table and counterfactual attribution outputs
statistics_and_uncertainty: Independent-replication intervals; exact n; family-wise coverage; selection/order interval
evidence_gate: All GOAL-12 numerical, precision, attribution and illustrative-factor gates pass
reviewer_risk: Waterfall/block changes may be misread as causal or order-invariant

scientific_question: Where do reversal and information value change across risk, dependence and flexibility?
core_conclusion: Operational flexibility governs both reversal regimes and whether more precise information changes feasible action
hero_panel: Fixed-factor reversal probability or classification over dependence by risk tolerance, faceted by flexibility
supporting_panels: Signal precision by flexibility information-value surface; actionability boundary; null/substitution examples
required_source_data: GOAL-12 controlled E3, E4 and E6 source tables; GOAL-14 information theorem conditions
statistics_and_uncertainty: Simultaneous intervals, sequential-stopping record, exact replications and crossing/face uncertainty
evidence_gate: GOAL-14 conditions classified and GOAL-12 controlled contrasts plus precision pass
reviewer_risk: A smooth heatmap can imply an unproved universal threshold or complementarity

scientific_question: When does apparent diversification conceal tail concentration or decision regret?
core_conclusion: Variance diversification can coexist with concentrated true-tail loss and regret when dependence is misspecified
hero_panel: True-law risk-return frontier against assumed-law frontier with chosen policies identified
supporting_panels: Marginal tail-loss contributions; concentration/support; variance versus tail-diversification quadrant; paired regret distribution
statistics_and_uncertainty: Paired independent-replication intervals, exact n and true-versus-assumed law labels
evidence_gate: GOAL-14 diversification definitions accepted and GOAL-12 true-law precision gate passes
reviewer_risk: Pseudo-diversification may be mistaken for a welfare theorem or crop-exclusion rule

scientific_question: Are observed acreage patterns consistent with model-linked predictions?
core_conclusion: Longer-horizon acreage transitions show where ranking discordance is robust, heterogeneous and consistent or inconsistent with named model predictions without revealing private optimality
hero_panel: Pre-decision rank/cardinal-gap transitions versus subsequent acreage-share transitions
supporting_panels: State/region heterogeneity with uncertainty; rolling/geographic validation; aggregation and national null; operational-proxy interaction if admissible
required_source_data: GOAL-15 frozen empirical transition, heterogeneity, holdout, aggregation and claim-boundary source tables
statistics_and_uncertainty: Cluster/block-aware intervals, exact n, multiplicity control and holdout metrics
evidence_gate: GOAL-15 data, timing, identification, robustness and replay gates pass
reviewer_risk: Observed consistency may be overread as mechanism, causality or revealed optimum
